## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track S (safety, trust and handoff behaviour), wave S1. This is audit backlog UX-06 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: Consultation → Checklist · doctor.
Findings and reviewers: F-09 · reviewer A-10.
Rationale: On opening a consultation the checklist already says Identity confirmed (name and date of birth) · Done; in code the item only means the banner was displayed. Every AI suggestion accepted or dismissed · Done shows although no AI drafting exists. The record of what was checked before signing overstates what happened.
Proposed UX behaviour: One of two, chosen by the pilot doctor. Either the item becomes Patient shown: name, date of birth, with no tick; or a real one-tap Confirmed with the patient at the start of the consultation, stored with who and when, which is what ticks the item. The AI line is hidden until AI drafting exists for the clinic. Signing stays locked until every remaining item is reviewed, as MDV-P2-044 built it.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/medvya-workspace-concept.html, audit note 7 (N to finish before signing).
Components and tokens affected: The checklist domain rule and panel. No new component.
Front end and back end split: Front end; back end only if the tap is chosen (a stored confirmation and audit event).
Prerequisites and blocked by: None in code.
Clinical sign-off: Required before merge: question 5 of the validation plan (a tap, or shown only), recorded on the issue with a date.
Effort and regression risk: S · Low.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Changing the other checklist items or the sign dialog. (2) Any AI feature.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a newly opened consultation, when the checklist is read, then no item about identity is marked done
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the tap option, when the doctor presses Confirmed with the patient, then the item is done and the record holds who and when; given the wording option, then the item reads Patient shown and has no tick
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a clinic with no AI drafting, when the checklist renders, then the AI line is absent
- [ ] **AC4.** Given unreviewed items, when the doctor tries to sign, then signing stays locked as today
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the unit test for the checklist, when the item is derived from the banner being displayed again, then the test fails
- [ ] **AC6.** Given English and Arabic, when axe runs on the checklist, then there is no violation and done is conveyed in words
